core_identity: Modern, luxurious, advanced, slightly calm. Not a typical flat tech app. Feels premium and highly localized for Saudi/Gulf.

spacing_and_layout.corners: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for pills and small buttons

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary_foreground rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold hover:opacity-90 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-bold

cards.listing_card: bg-surface rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 relative
cards.category_card: aspect-square rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-border bg-surface_elevated

navigation.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border flex justify-around py-4 z-50
navigation.top_bar: sticky top-0 w-full bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-xl z-40 flex justify-between items-center py-4 px-4

special.ai_badge: absolute top-2 right-2 bg-primary/20 text-primary border border-primary/30 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1

pages_layout.home: Top bar with search & dark mode toggle. Hero section with abstract luxury banner. Horizontal scrollable Reels/Stories avatars. Bento grid of 15+ categories. 'Featured Nearby' section using listing_cards.
pages_layout.listing_detail: Image gallery header with 360 viewer overlay toggle. Price block with AI 'Good Price' badge. Seller profile card. Map block showing exact pin. Sticky bottom action bar (Chat, Call, Offer).
pages_layout.post_listing: Multi-step form. Step 1: Visual category selector. Step 2: Dynamic fields (auto-changes based on category). Step 3: Media upload. Step 4: AI enhancements.
pages_layout.chat: WhatsApp style. Header with seller info. Message bubbles (Light: gray/baby blue, Dark: slate/baby blue). Bottom input with attach/voice icons.
pages_layout.map: Full screen map. Custom map_pin_assets. Bottom sheet for selected listing preview. Toggle for 'Heatmap' in header.
pages_layout.auctions: Live video/image header. Massive countdown timer. Scrolling bid history feed. Fixed bottom bid input with preset increments (+100, +500).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global support for direction: rtl. Arabic is the primary language.
Implement a strict Light/Dark mode toggle. Default is Light. Dark mode MUST use solid dark navy (#0A1128), no gradients, to meet E1 rules.
When applying font classes, use 'font-arabic' for Alexandria/Tajawal and 'font-latin' for Outfit/Plus Jakarta Sans. If implementing quickly, standardizing on Alexandria for headings globally works.
Build the UI in React (.js files, not .tsx) using Tailwind CSS.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for consistent, high-end iconography. The 'Messages' icon must be prominently featured in the bottom nav.
DO NOT USE INTER FONT. DO NOT USE GENERIC PURPLE/TEAL GRADIENTS. Stick to the Baby Blue and Navy scheme.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Include 'الجديد' in a smaller font size next to 'الحراج' in the top app bar.
